name: solidity-english-nft-auctions
title: English NFT auction escrow
description: ERC721 English auctions with token bids, anti-sniping extensions, reserve prices and pull refunds.
assumptions: No auction fees or royalties. Bids escrow the full new amount and return old bids as credits. Recipient contracts must accept ERC721 safe transfer at settlement. Anti-sniping extension can prolong auctions indefinitely under continued bids.
